landing.howItWorksSubtitle: Find free drinking water anywhere in Italy in three steps.

steps.openMapDesc: Open the interactive map and instantly see fountains, public toilets, and bike parking.
steps.searchAreaDesc: Use the search by city, town, or street to center the map exactly where you need it.
steps.filterDesc: Select only what matters to you: fountains, toilets, bike parking, or playgrounds.

landing.citiesSubtitle: Find drinking fountains in the country's most important cities

cities.romeDesc: The capital offers hundreds of historic and modern fountains. From the iconic "nasoni" to water points in parks, there is always a free place to get a drink.
cities.milanDesc: In Lombardy's capital, find fountains easily in parks, train stations, and neighborhoods. Perfect for anyone traveling by bike or on foot.
cities.florenceDesc: In the cradle of the Renaissance, discover artistic and functional fountains. Ideal for tourists visiting museums and historic monuments.
cities.turinDesc: The Savoy capital offers many water points in its elegant parks and along the historic center. Fresh mountain water is always available.
cities.naplesDesc: In Campania's capital, find relief at public fountains. They are especially useful during hot summer days while exploring the city.
cities.moreDesc: Our map covers all of Italy! Find fountains in Bologna, Genoa, Palermo, Bari, Venice, and hundreds of other cities and towns.

faq.potableAnswer: Yes, public fountain water in Italy is generally drinkable and safe to drink. It is regularly checked by local health authorities. In case of temporary issues, signs are displayed warning against use.
faq.report: Can I report a new fountain?
faq.reportAnswer: The data comes from OpenStreetMap, a collaborative project. You can contribute directly by editing OpenStreetMap to add new fountains or update existing information. Changes will also appear on our map.
faq.search: How can I search for a specific city?
faq.searchAnswer: It's easy! The map includes a search bar at the top. Type the name of a city, town, or specific street and the map will center itself automatically, showing all points of interest in that area.
faq.coverageAnswer: Yes, coverage extends throughout Italy! Availability depends on how thoroughly each area has been mapped in OpenStreetMap. Major cities have more complete coverage, and we keep expanding into smaller towns.
faq.offlineAnswer: The app is designed as a Progressive Web App (PWA) and can work with limited connectivity. Once the map has loaded, you can keep browsing information even without an internet connection.

landing.finalTitle: Start finding fountains near you now!
landing.finalDescription: Join thousands of people who already discovered how to drink free water across Italy while contributing to environmental sustainability.

credits.title: Credits
credits.description: Information about the Fontanelle in Italia project, its motivation, OpenStreetMap data sources, and how to support the app.
credits.motivationBody0: I started using a bicycle for my daily trips and quickly realized I needed fast information about essential services along the way:
credits.motivationBody1: Drinking fountains to refill my bottle
credits.motivationBody4: Playgrounds to take my daughter on our bike outings
credits.motivationBody5: I initially focused the app on Milan, but given its usefulness I decided to expand it across Italy, creating a practical and immediate tool for cyclists and families on the move.
credits.dataBody0: All map data comes from OpenStreetMap, a collaborative project to build a free, editable map of the world.
credits.dataBody1: OpenStreetMap is created by a community of mappers who contribute and maintain data about roads, trails, cafes, train stations, and much more worldwide.
credits.dataBody2: If you find missing or inaccurate information, you can contribute directly to OpenStreetMap to improve the data not only for this app but for the whole community.
credits.developmentBody0: This application was built with Next.js and uses several open source libraries, including Leaflet for map rendering and DaisyUI for the interface.
credits.developmentBody1: The code for this app is fully open source and available on GitHub. I chose to open source the project as a way to give back to the community, recognizing that this app would not have been possible without the many open source projects that came before it.
credits.supportBody0: This app is developed and maintained in my spare time, with passion and dedication. Hosting, domain, and maintenance costs are personally covered, and every bit of help matters to keep the service alive, updated, and improving.
credits.supportBody1: Your support is a key incentive to keep investing time and energy into this project, letting us expand features and maintain the necessary infrastructure.
credits.shareProjectBody: Sharing is the simplest but most powerful way to support us! Tell friends, family, or social media followers so more cyclists and families can discover this resource.
credits.financialSupportBody: If the app is useful to you and you'd like to support it financially, you can do so through:
credits.closingNote: Every contribution, big or small, makes a difference. Thanks for supporting this open source project!

contribute.title: Add a POI
contribute.description: Add a drinking fountain, public toilet, bike parking or playground directly on OpenStreetMap.
contribute.osmNote: This tool adds the point directly to OpenStreetMap, the shared map database, and NOT to this app. Your contribution won't be visible here right away: Fontanelle refreshes its data from OpenStreetMap periodically, so the new POI will appear after the next update.
contribute.authFailed: OpenStreetMap authentication failed. Please try logging in again.
contribute.missingCoords: No starting point provided. Tap the minimap to choose the position.
contribute.loginDescription: To add a new point you need to authorize this app with your OpenStreetMap account. You will be asked for write access to the map data.
contribute.minimapHint: Drag the pin or tap the map to adjust the exact position.
contribute.typeTitle: What do you want to add?
contribute.submitError: Something went wrong while adding the POI. Please try again.
